topic.label: Atmosphere/Energy
topic.desc: Atmosphere/Energy: atmospheric science, climate and the energy systems that drive and respond to them.

concepts: Motion of the atmosphere from geostrophic flow to storms, governed by pressure gradients, rotation and buoyancy.
Solar and infrared radiation, greenhouse forcing and the planetary energy budget.
Climate change detection, attribution and projection with general circulation models and scenarios.
Generation, conversion efficiency, grids and storage across fossil, nuclear and renewable sources.
Solar, wind, hydro and geothermal resource assessment and the variability of their output.
Pollutant emissions, air quality, carbon pricing and policy for energy transitions.
skills: Computes geostrophic and gradient wind from pressure fields, checked by unit balance and comparison with observed winds.
Evaluates lapse rates and convective potential from soundings, checked against computed CAPE and lifted index.
Explains Hadley, Ferrel and polar cells and jet streams, checked against reanalysis climatology.
Builds a zero-dimensional energy balance model and solves for equilibrium temperature, checked by flux closure.
Estimates forcing from greenhouse gas concentration changes with standard formulas, checked against published values.
Summarizes direct and indirect aerosol effects and their uncertainty, checked against cited literature.
Compares projected warming across emissions scenarios, checked against model ensemble ranges.
Quantifies water vapor, cloud and ice albedo feedbacks and sensitivity, checked by feedback sum consistency.
Fits trends to temperature records with uncertainty, checked by significance tests and dataset agreement.
Computes thermodynamic and plant efficiencies for energy conversion chains, checked by energy conservation.
Models hourly grid supply and demand with storage dispatch, checked by matching load at every step.
Compares batteries, pumped hydro and hydrogen by cost and round-trip efficiency, checked against cited figures.
Estimates photovoltaic yield from irradiance and panel parameters, checked against capacity factor benchmarks.
Fits wind speed distributions and turbine power curves to estimate annual output, checked by Weibull fit quality.
Maps candidate renewable sites against resource and land constraints, checked by layer overlay rules.
Builds a pollutant and carbon emissions inventory from activity data and factors, checked by totals reconciliation.
Analyses carbon tax and cap-and-trade effects on generation mix, checked against stated model assumptions.
Analyses ozone and particulate concentrations against air quality standards, checked against monitoring data.
